name: fmp_institutional_holders
description:
Institutional holders of one stock from Financial Modeling Prep (FMP, /stable/institutional-holder): holder name, shares held, change in position and filing date.
Returns {symbol, holders}: FMP's list of holder records.
Inputs (* required): symbol* (ticker, e.g. AAPL; upper-cased).
For mutual funds use fmp_mutual_fund_holders; for one fund's whole portfolio fmp_13f_filing; for insiders fmp_insider_trading.
Needs an FMP API key (config fmp.api.key, env FMP_API_KEY); without one it returns a demo placeholder naming the endpoint instead of data.
Example: {"symbol": "AAPL"}
